snippet.title: Street Chef Simulator - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🌭Fire up the grill and start your culinary empire! Street Chef Simulator, demo available now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3698450/Street_Chef_Simulator_Demo/

Push your hotdog cart through a vibrant coastal city and build your street food business from the ground up. Master the grill, manage your daily earnings, and customize your stand to attract hungry customers. Serve up classic hotdogs, expand your menu, unlock new carts, and become the ultimate street food tycoon!

#CookingSimulator #SimulatorGame #IndieGames #StreetFood #Gaming #GameTrailer #IndieDev #CookingGame
